highYieldAssessment.breadth: One contemporary table spans Europe, South America, Asia, Africa and North America, with many country/unit pairs and repeated China units.
highYieldAssessment.usefulFirstOutput: Dated quoted-monetary-unit evidence at1930 snapshot, followed only where unambiguous by separate exchange-rate observations. This is not a full-year legal-currency catalogue.
